name: Sceva
title: Jewish high priest in Ephesus
summary: Sceva was a Jewish high priest (or someone claiming to be one) living in Ephesus. He is known from the Acts of the Apostles as the father of seven sons who attempted to cast out evil spirits in the name of Jesus without having faith in Jesus themselves, which ended catastrophically for them. The event led to a great revival in Ephesus and demonstrated that God's power cannot be manipulated.

keyEvents.title: Sceva's sons attempt to cast out evil spirits
keyEvents.description: Sceva's seven sons, who were traveling Jewish exorcists, tried to use the name of Jesus to cast out evil spirits by saying: "I adjure you by the Jesus whom Paul proclaims."

keyEvents.title: The Evil Spirit's Answer
keyEvents.description: The evil spirit answered them: 'Jesus I know, and Paul I know about, but who are you?' This showed that the spirit world knew of Jesus and Paul, but did not recognize the authority of Sceva's sons.

keyEvents.title: The Sons Are Overpowered
keyEvents.description: The man with the evil spirit jumped on them, overpowered all of them, and attacked them so violently that they fled from the house naked and beaten.

keyEvents.title: Fear Falls Over Ephesus
keyEvents.description: When this became known to both Jews and Greeks in Ephesus, fear fell upon them all, and the name of the Lord Jesus was held in high honor. The event showed that God's power cannot be misused.

keyEvents.title: Great Revival and Repentance in Ephesus
keyEvents.description: Many who had come to faith confessed and openly reported what they had been doing. A large number of those who practiced magic arts gathered their books and burned them publicly.
